g.title: gfc--module

g.data-description: circuit breaker switch (40 A) EBAT-B, legend B-40A (callout 4)
circuit breaker switch (40 A) EBAT-A, legend A-40A (callout 5)
female 50-pin micro D-sub, 'External Alarms' - seventeen external alarm inputs and outputs, external ACO, and visual and audible critical, major and minor relay contacts (UDS Table 115)
six-pin right-angle wire-wrap header, recessed behind the panel, for the BITS inputs to NT-A and NT-B with frame ground between (UDS Table 116)
alarm cut-off push button (callout 13)
the hinged 'Energy Hazard' shield over the terminal block
EBATRET connector, double-hole lug on two M5 studs (callout 1, upper)
EBATRET connector, double-hole lug on two M5 studs (callout 1, lower)
EBAT-A branch connector, double-hole lug on two M5 studs (callout 3)
EBAT-B branch connector, double-hole lug on two M5 studs (callout 2)

the DB-9 remote craft port (RS-232, UDS Table 117). The alarm I/O D-sub and the BITS header are management too, but no library part exists for either, so they are elements of this card and cannot join a group.
